metrics.title: Incident measurements
metrics.expectedNote: Seasonal baseline, this weekday and hour
metrics.confidenceLimited: Confidence limited because baseline variability is zero. See technical details.

lifecycle.empty: No transitions recorded. The anomaly exists but its lifecycle audit trail is empty, which is itself unexpected — the engine writes a transition for every state change.

top.noEvents: No contributor comparison is available for a zero-event interval. There were no events to compare against the baseline, so nothing here has been ruled out.
top.pending: Contributor evidence is still being collected. This is a backlog, not a finding.
top.failed: No contributors: evidence collection failed (see the notice below).
top.unavailable: No contributor evidence is available for this anomaly. No field has been examined, so nothing has been ruled out.
top.capped: From a result capped at the value limit — the top of the list, not the whole of it.

dimensions.failed: Evidence collection failed; see the notice above.
dimensions.none: No dimension analysis is stored for this anomaly. No field has been examined, so nothing here has been ruled out.
dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.unchecked: {count, plural, one {# dimension was} other {# dimensions were}} not checked: {labels}. No conclusion about {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} follows from this investigation.

contributors.queryFailed: The query for this dimension did not complete, so it has not been checked.
contributors.notPopulated: This field was not populated by the QRadar parser for this log source, so it has not been checked. No conclusion follows from the absence of contributors here.
contributors.noneStandOut: This dimension was collected and no value stood out as a contributor.
contributors.truncated: Truncated at the configured value cap — this is the top of the list, not the whole of it.
contributors.caption: {label} values ranked by their contribution to the change, with baseline and anomaly counts.

status.PARTIAL: Some QRadar fields were unavailable or truncated. The available evidence is shown below; the dimensions that were not collected have not been checked, and no conclusion follows from the absence of contributors there.
status.UNAVAILABLE: This log source's DSM exposes none of the requested fields for this interval, so no contributor analysis was possible. This is a property of the source, not a transient error.
status.FAILED: Contributor evidence collection failed. Detection metrics and lifecycle data remain available, and this says nothing about what happened during the anomaly — it is worth retrying.
status.PENDING: Contributor evidence is still being collected. The analysis below is not yet available: this is a backlog, not a finding.
status.NOT_REQUESTED: No evidence collection has been requested for this anomaly. Nothing has been looked at.

banner.truncated: Some results were limited to the top values ({dimensions}). New, disappeared and cardinality counts cannot be determined under a cap — a value can look new simply because it fell below the cap in the other window — so those counts are withheld rather than reported.

technical.noDetection: This anomaly recorded no structured detector evidence, so the thresholds behind its verdict cannot be shown.
technical.noPackage: No evidence package is stored for this anomaly. Nothing about the anomalous interval has been queried from QRadar.
technical.queriesNote: How the evidence was obtained. Query structure only — no credentials, headers or raw event payloads are recorded or shown. Each statement carries the START and STOP bounds that scoped it.
technical.noQueries: No queries were recorded for this package.
technical.collectionSourceValue: QRadar Ariel, via the backend collector
